content: राध् I. €5 <ab>P.</ab> (राध्नोति, राद्ध; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} रिरात्सति, but रित्सति to ‘wish to kill’) .²1 To propitiate, conciliate, please. .²2 To accomplish, effect, complete, perform, achieve. .²3 To prepare, make ready. .²4 To fall to the lot of any one (also €4 <ab>P.</ab>). .²5 To injure, destroy, kill, exterminate; वानरा भूधरान् रेधुः <ls>Bk. 14. 19</ls>. --II. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (राध्यति, राद्ध) .²1 To be favourable or merciful. .²2 To be accomplished or finished. .²3 To propitiate, look to the welfare of (any one, with <ab>dat.</ab>); कृष्णाय राध्यति गर्गः <ls>Sk.</ls> ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} पृष्टो गर्गः शुभाशुभं पर्यालोचयति). .²4 To be successful, to succeed, prosper. .²5 To be ready. .²6 To kill, destroy. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (राधयति-ते) .²1 To propitiate. .²2 To accomplish, complete. .²3 To make ready.
